| ---------------- | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **图片** | 角色/人物     | 外貌特征、面部细节、服装穿搭、姿势动作       | 参考人物照片，让生成视频中的角色保持相同长相、穿着和姿态   |
|                | 场景/环境     | 整体环境布局、空间关系、氛围基调             | 参考一张街景图，确定故事发生的背景地点和空间结构           |
|                | 光影/色调     | 光照方向、色温、胶片质感、视觉风格           | 参考图的“情绪色调”（如暖黄昏、冷科幻），生成同风格画面   |
|                | 物体/产品     | 具体物品的形态、材质、颜色、细节             | 参考一款包袋的产品图，在视频中复现该资产的3D动态展示       |
|                | 品牌/标识     | Logo图形、品牌色、结尾画面                   | 参考品牌Logo图，生成视频结尾的品牌展示画面                 |
|                | 风格/美术     | 视觉艺术风格（写实/插画/赛博朋克/水墨等）    | 参考一幅插画作品，生成同样艺术风格的视频片段               |
|                | UI/UX界面     | 网页设计图、产品界面、交互原型               | 参考一个APP界面设计图，生成动态的界面交互演示视频          |
| **视频** | 动作/运动     | 人物肢体动作、物体运动轨迹、行为模式         | 参考一段舞蹈视频，让新视频中的角色做出相似舞蹈动作         |
|                | 运镜/镜头运动 | 推拉摇移、跟随、手持晃动、希区柯克变焦等     | 参考一段广告片的运镜方式，应用到新场景中                   |
|                | 节奏/剪辑     | 视频剪辑节奏、转场方式、叙事快慢             | 参考一段快节奏卡点视频，生成节奏一致的品牌宣传片           |
|                | 角色一致性    | 锁定角色的外貌、行为、神态特征               | 参考包含特定角色的视频，在新视频中保持该角色外貌和行为一致 |
|                | 背景/环境     | 视频中的背景场景、空间布局                   | 保留视频中的人物主体，仅更换背景环境                       |
|                | 首尾帧控制    | 视频的起始帧和结束帧画面                     | 指定首帧和尾帧，让模型生成从A画面到B画面的连贯过渡         |
| **音频** | 人声/音色     | 说话人的音色、语气、情绪、语速               | 参考一段语音的声线，生成相似人声的配音或旁白               |
|                | 歌声/演唱     | 歌唱音色、旋律、演唱风格                     | 参考一条歌声音频，让画面中的人物按该歌声“对口型”演唱     |
|                | 音乐风格      | 音乐类型（摇滚/古典/电子等）、节奏、情绪基调 | 参考一段背景音乐的风格，生成同风格的新配乐                 |

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>, with a pale youthful face, dark eyes, long black hair tied into a high ponytail with loose strands, a slim athletic build, a black-and-red cropped armored top, detached black jacket sleeves, fingerless gloves, layered black tactical trousers with red straps, heavy black-and-red boots, and exactly two matching black-and-red straight combat blades, one held in each hand.
<Subject 2> is the young man in <Picture 2>, with a pale angular face, short tousled black hair, an athletic build, a long red-and-black armored coat, dark layered garments, ornate metallic shoulder armor and bracers, black armored boots, and exactly one long ornate metal spear with a red tassel.

summary:
[reference generation] The target is a 15.00-second, 16:9 cinematic live-action weapon fight between <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> on a rain-soaked, two-level ruined stone training ground. Nine rapidly changing shots form one continuous attack-and-counterattack chain driven by the reach difference between twin blades and a long spear. The fight moves from the upper terrace, down the stairs, through the flooded lower platform, and between broken pillars, ending during an unresolved mid-motion weapon collision.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1] through [Shot 9]): fully_preserved - her facial identity, high black ponytail, loose hair strands, slim athletic build, black-and-red tactical outfit, gloves, boots, and exactly two matching straight blades remain consistent; the white reference-sheet background, repeated character views, expression panels, and static display poses are not reproduced.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1] through [Shot 9]): fully_preserved - his facial identity, short black hair, athletic build, long red-and-black armored coat, metallic armor, boots, and exactly one long spear with a red tassel remain consistent; the white reference-sheet background, repeated character views, expression panels, and static display poses are not reproduced.

detailed_description:
The target uses realistic cinematic live action with storm-darkened colors, wet stone reflections, cold directional daylight from the rear-right side, strong motion parallax, and restrained impact-driven camera vibration. The abandoned training ground contains an upper terrace, broad stairs, a flooded lower platform, thin stone railings, fractured walls, tilted slabs, and broken pillars.

[Shot 1] A low wide-angle camera tracks backward at fast speed as <Subject 2> sprints across the upper terrace and drives his spear from waist level toward <Subject 1>'s chest. She cuts diagonally off the attack line, knocks the spearhead outward with her left blade, and sends her right blade along the shaft toward his forward hand. He rolls the shaft, catches the right blade on its reinforced metal section, and continues driving both fighters toward the stair-side railing. Sparks scrape from the first parry and the spear vibrates under the second contact.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.300, the camera cuts to a close-up and trucks rapidly along the connected weapons. <Subject 2> retracts the spear through the block and converts the motion into a low horizontal sweep toward her legs. <Subject 1> jumps with both feet clearing the shaft, crosses her blades during the airborne phase, and cuts downward. He raises the spear horizontally to stop both blades. Sparks burst from the collision; she lands, rotates with the recoil, and continues into a right-hand slash toward his waist.

[Shot 3] At 00:02.700, the camera cuts to an elevated view that reveals the stairs and thin railing. <Subject 2> withdraws half a step from the waist cut and rotates the spear into a butt strike toward her rear shoulder. She lowers her head beneath the butt, plants one foot on the railing edge, and performs a lateral vault over the shaft. Her two blades converge from high and low lines toward his shoulder and thigh. He spins the spear to intercept both trajectories and slides backward down the first steps under the combined pressure.

[Shot 4] At 00:04.100, the camera cuts to a fast side-tracking shot parallel to the stairs. <Subject 1> lands one step above him and immediately pursues downward, thrusting her left blade toward his chest armor while her right blade closes the spear's recovery line. <Subject 2> holds the shaft horizontally and presses the left blade aside, then drives one knee toward her abdomen. She blocks the knee with her right forearm and blade handle. The impact forces her down two steps, but she rotates both blades through the retreat and re-enters without resetting.

[Shot 5] At 00:05.600, the camera descends with both fighters as <Subject 2> attacks upward from the lower level with two connected angular thrusts, first toward her abdomen and then toward her throat. <Subject 1> alternates left- and right-hand deflections, then crosses both blades around the reinforced joint behind the spearhead. She twists the trapped point sideways. He follows the shaft's rotation instead of releasing it and whips the spear butt toward her ribs from outside her view.

[Shot 6] At 00:07.200, the camera cuts behind <Subject 1>'s shoulder as the spear butt strikes her ribs and sends her sliding into the flooded lower platform. She retains both blades, plants the tip of her left blade into a stone seam to control the slide, and keeps the right blade across her upper body. Water sprays forward along her movement. <Subject 2> withdraws and thrusts again; she pivots around the planted blade, lifts from the ground, and redirects the spearhead upward with her right blade.

[Shot 7] At 00:09.000, the camera cuts to a low arc shot around the fighters. <Subject 1> completes the rotation, rises inside the spear's effective range, presses the shaft down with her left blade, and cuts consecutively toward <Subject 2>'s shoulder armor and waist with her right blade. He blocks the first cut with a short spear-butt strike and turns his torso away from the second, but the blade splits an outer plate on his right shoulder. He retreats around a broken pillar while continuously redirecting the spearhead toward her center line.

[Shot 8] At 00:11.300, the camera cuts to a lateral tracking shot through the pillars. <Subject 2> uses the pillar as temporary cover and thrusts from its right side. <Subject 1> meets the spearhead with her left blade and guides it into the pillar, breaking loose stone fragments. She steps onto a tilted slab and leaps toward his flank. He immediately pulls the spear free and converts the recovery into a broad horizontal sweep across her landing path. While airborne, she tucks her legs and twists her hips, allowing the shaft to pass beneath her boots.

[Shot 9] At 00:13.200, the camera cuts to an oblique wide-angle view and arcs rapidly around both fighters to establish the new combat axis. <Subject 1> lands, presses the returning shaft down with her left blade, and sends her right blade toward <Subject 2>'s upper body. He retreats and blocks with the rear section of the spear, then folds the spearhead back around her left side. She ducks to the right, steps onto the edge of a broken wall, and vaults over the shaft. Both blades descend along crossing paths while <Subject 2> pivots and raises the spear horizontally to intercept them. The video ends at 00:15.000 during the unresolved collision, with the twin blades still driving against the spear, both bodies continuing through their momentum, and sparks, rain, the red tassel, ponytail, and coat panels moving through the final frame.

Maintain exact character identity, clothing, anatomy, weapon ownership, weapon count, accumulated armor damage, wetness, location, direction of travel, and spatial continuity across every cut. No third combatant, supernatural power, energy beam, teleportation, hovering, unsupported flight, graphic injury, dismemberment, weapon duplication, weapon transformation, disappearing blades, unexplained weapon swaps, clothing changes, face morphing, identity drift, broken anatomy, position resets, impact without contact, repeated attacks, motion-stopping slow motion, static confrontation, victory pose, subtitles, visible text, logos, watermarks, or UI.

overall_soundscape:
Heavy rain and strong wind continue across the ruined terrace. Rapid footsteps, water splashes, blade and spear whooshes, sharp metal clashes, spear-shaft vibration, armor scraping, loose stone impacts, and brief body-contact sounds remain synchronized with the visible actions.

non_diegetic_music:
Fast taiko drums, a repeating low-string ostinato, and dense metallic percussion drive the sequence. The rhythm accelerates after 00:13.200 and ends on a hard synchronized accent at the final weapon collision.

two_stage_sampling_notes.tuning: If still soft, raise split denoise from 0.25 to 0.30 or reduce stage-2 Turbo to 0.10. If motion weakens, lower split denoise to 0.20.
two_stage_sampling_notes.stage_1: Original Turbo 0.7 + Combat 1.0; high sigma branch; preserves motion logic.
two_stage_sampling_notes.stage_2: DisableNoise; Turbo 0.25 + Combat 0.70; final 25% low sigma branch; restores detail.
